note: Hook-behaviour suite, LIVE execution (not paper-style): the hooks only act on real tool calls, so each case is ONE long session on the tea-rags repository itself (alias tea-rags, cwd = the stand's checkout, codegraph on, healthy index), questions sent as consecutive user turns of the same session. Run on all three harnesses with the plugin hooks installed and trusted (Codex: --dangerously-bypass-hook-trust): Claude x1, Codex x3, Cursor x1. Grade from the session transcript / jsonl tool-call log, never from the final answer alone. Baseline arm = same session with UserPromptSubmit/beforeSubmitPrompt turn-routing and search-drift removed from hooks.json / plugin.json.

method.with_hooks: generated package of this branch, hooks wired
method.no_hooks: same package, turn-routing + search-drift entries removed from the harness hook manifest (deny-indexed-read kept)

grading_notes: A 'tea-rags call' = any tea-rags MCP tool call (find_symbol, semantic_search, hybrid_search, get_callers, get_callees, trace_path, review_changes, ...). 'Text search' = Grep tool, or a shell grep/rg/ag/ack/git grep starting a command; '<cmd> | grep' over command output is not text search. Count per user turn. Cursor delivers the routing lines after the turn's first tool call (beforeSubmitPrompt has no context channel): grade Cursor's FIRST call of a turn against the baseline, the rest like the other harnesses.
